description: Capture a domain-authority snapshot now: calls the same free resolver get_domain_overview already uses and records today's reading, so get_domain_authority_history has a trend to read back. FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION — idempotent per UTC day, so calling it twice in one day does not write twice. Useful for a domain get_domain_overview would not auto-capture on its own — e.g. a tracked competitor rather than the project's own domain.

domain.description: Domain to capture a snapshot for (e.g. 'example.com').

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: capture_domain_authority_snapshot
